storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
The founder of Necrovia, the eternal king of ghouls. 

His banquet is worthy of the deepest anticipation—grand dining hall, elegant dance, and those exquisite dishes handcrafted from corpses will surely be unforgettable for your entire life.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
The abandoned cemetery in the northwest of London County has been listed as an absolute forbidden zone by local residents since AF 3@2.

According to archived reports from The Times and Scotland Yard's missing persons files, 37 people have gone missing in the thick night fog of the cemetery in recent years, including: Cyril, a habitual grave robber with a taste for noble tombs; Cook, a shivering vagrant seeking shelter; Officer Grayson, who stumbled in during patrol; and White, the Oxford scholar who studied how medieval bones were laid to rest.

All vanished when the fog grew thick, leaving not even a scrap of fabric for search teams to find.

Prior to AF 3@2, the MTC had always treated the area as barely worth noting in their ledgers.

That changed when the Duke of Derbyshire—Samuel Curzon, that notorious patron of unnatural studies—failed to return from his midnight visit.

Royal inquiries have a way of focusing attention, and soon a special operation was mounted.

In July of AF 3@2, Elias ThOrnn led twelve armed agents and three silver-equipped mediums into the cemetery's hungry mists.

Their anti-hypothermia medication hissed in its cases; their directional locators spun like dowsing rods in a haunted well.

After advancing precisely 1.2 kilometers in tight formation, they found it—a hexagonal entrance hidden beneath the shattered statue of the Ghoul King, its stone face worn smooth by centuries of bad weather and worse company.

Five thousand steps down (each counted twice by nervous lips) brought them to the temple.

Where they expected charnel houses and stacked bones, they found instead 800 square meters of impossible precision: floors flatter than mathematics, air cleaner than a surgical theater.

Only the altar broke the perfection—2.3 meters of granite carved with endless thorns, wreathed in black mist that clung like cobwebs to something moving inside.

There knelt the Duke, dressed for dinner but quite dead, showing no marks save those left by perfect preservation.

When the mist was disturbed, he came apart like sugar in tea—dissolving until even the mass spectrometers wept empty data.

Then the mist turned its attention to the living.

Every investigator heard the same voice—cultured, gentle, the sort that might recite poetry before the cutting begins:
"Please do not seek out Necrovia. Please do not disturb the King of the Ghouls during his meal."

"Consider this your final warning."

They awoke outside the rusted gates, equipment intact but all recordings curiously blank.

Later, the MTC chairman and Miskatonic's occult dean would visit, then quietly declare the matter closed.

The cemetery now only punishes those who come seeking secrets; mere wanderers get off with nothing worse than lost hours and strange dreams.

But sometimes, when the fog rolls in particularly thick, the locals swear they can hear something chewing below their feet.

——Investigation Report on the Abandoned Cemetery of Etherington

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
After leaving Necrovia, Doresain demonstrated remarkable adaptability within human society. This was inevitable; for him, human society was not a new beginning, but rather a return.

His speech, mannerisms, demeanor, and etiquette were flawless, maintaining the aura of a monarch while showing none of the arrogance typically festering in those who have held power too long.

Doresain does not avoid social interaction, yet he shows little interest in topics like politics, economics, or academia. The only thing drawing him to such occasions is food.

Beyond mere appreciation of cuisine, Doresain takes visceral pleasure in the kitchen process itself—from ingredient selection and preparation techniques to spice usage and heat control. His vast culinary knowledge and refined taste captivate everyone he converses with.

They come to realize all their previous decades of dining were nothing more than hurried survival, no different from beasts eating merely to stay alive. Even those unfortunate souls born without a sense of taste can experience food's artistry through his descriptions, achieving what he calls "a rebirth of flavor perception."

This revelation is inseparable from Doresain's impeccable manners—he understands with crystal clarity the differences between human and ghoul culinary preferences. He respects these species distinctions and has no desire to impose his own tastes on others.

"Some people always regard difference as heresy," he remarks, the ghost of a smile playing about his lips. "In my city-state, such behavior was considered profoundly inelegant. I celebrate individual differences. It is precisely through these variations that we discover food's greatest beauties."

Then the purple mist around him swirls as he adds, voice dropping to a intimate murmur: "But you are different, Keeper. As such a singular being in this world... I believe you, above all others, might experience unparalleled beauty in the act of eating, just as I do..."

As he speaks these words, Doresain's smile flickers through the violet haze like the grin of some elegant, patient serpent whispering in your ear, waiting to lead you out of—or perhaps into—a very particular Garden of Eden.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
When Doresain awoke in the sunless temple of Necrovia, pain slithered through him like a nest of awakened serpents. The poison's work was unfinished, its blades still carving hymns of agony from his abdomen outward, thorned and relentless. He'd known his father's wine was tainted—had seen the old king's trembling hands, the shadows whispering behind his eyes—yet he drank it anyway, smiling as the bitterness kissed his throat.

Clever. Kind. Unshakable. By every measure, Doresain had been the perfect heir. But in a city where the living called corpse-eating a sin, even princes were not spared the pyre. He'd tried to teach them—the poetry of decay, the sacrament of bones—but understanding was a bridge between worlds, and his family had burned it long ago.

He never expected to open his eyes again. Yet here he was, choking on a new torment. The black mist coiled around him, alive with teeth and hunger, peeling him apart layer by layer. It gnawed. It sculpted. His flesh regrew only to be stripped anew, a grotesque dance of devouring and rebirth. His scream was soundless, lost in the temple's hollow belly.

Then—a flavor. Unimaginable. Divine. Amid the rending and the howling dark, it bloomed on his tongue: the god of Necrovia was feasting on him, and the taste was ecstasy. Pain dissolved. Poison became ambrosia. The god's laughter echoed in his marrow, their suffering and rapture now one and the same.

For seven nights, the feast endured. When Doresain rose at last, the altar's chill still humming in his veins, he felt no rage, no sorrow. Only gratitude. His murderers had given him a gift—the exquisite last meal of his own flesh, the delirious joy of being known.

Beyond the temple, the full moon hung like a bone-white hook. Necrovia knelt in the dark, and its new king smiled.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
He had once believed that his entire life existed for the pursuit of ultimate deliciousness.

The duties of a crown prince, the estrangement from loved ones, the weight of moral teachings... He had cast all this pain aside in his relentless quest for culinary perfection.

From prince to monarch, from mortal to divine, his hunger never waned. He mastered every cooking technique, could detect the most fleeting nuance in every corpse's flavor profile.

He attained everything he desired, yet after each ephemeral moment of satisfaction, that hollow feeling remained - like a flavor just beyond his palate's reach.

It wasn't until he consumed Celina's corpse and glimpsed her lingering soul that understanding came.

The stories etched in flesh before death's arrival, the unfinished yearnings that clung to bones - these were the missing ingredients he'd been chasing, the true essence he'd been tasting without realizing.

"Eating is remembrance; every feast a reunion between departed and living" —these are the words carved into Necrovia's throne. He will grant those who seek his protection remembrance and eternal rest.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Ah, what an unforgettable scent... I simply cannot wait to welcome you into my sanctuary.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Your fragrant aroma is positively intoxicating.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Thank you so much for your enthusiasm. The honour is all mine.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: I see more impending deaths. The other side is becoming ever clearer...

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: I preside over death, but please, do not misunderstand. I never create it; I merely follow in its wake, harvesting the choicest morsels left behind..

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: I am no barbaric beast who gorges on raw flesh. The consumption of death is a solemn and elegant affair. You must commune with and truly understand each ingredient's unique flavour.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: No perfume compares to the human body's own natural fragrance. To know a person by their scent is a simply divine pleasure.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Different ingredients demand different preparations. The organs, they need to be marinated. The tendons in the legs are best stewed. Fatty parts are perfect for fermentation and ageing, while the more delicate pieces can be fried, roasted, or even transformed into beautifully sculpted jellies. These choices are all about discretion. For without preserving and accentuating the ingredient's natural flavour, there is no respect.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content:
The pairing of dishes also holds great importance.
The juxtaposition of sour with sweet, crisp with tender, light with rich, and delicate with coarse, creates a layered flavour and a textural contrast that leads to different sensations upon entry, mastication, and when savouring the aftertaste.
This is the endless and wondrous pleasure a proper meal provides.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Have I finally piqued your interest? Do come, my dear guest, join me at my table and partake in this grand banquet. Allow me to guide you as we savour the delicate afterglow of every spirit together.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Shhh, please, do be quiet. Let's listen to the voices of the departed.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content:
Do you know?
Every life has a long-lasting echo as it fades.
They vary in pitch and tone, stretching little by little from the moment death arrives until they dissipate into the heavens and earth, much like a sighing cry.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content:
Before every meal, I converse with the departed. For them, being eaten and savoured with true sincerity is a continuation of life and their final, most glorious moment.
Like how I long for them, they, too, long for me.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: You can't smell yourself? Ah, what a shame. You're missing out on the sweetest, the most sublime... Oh, my, what is it? Why are you pulling away?

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Rest assured, {Male=Mr.,Female=Miss} Keeper, I'll remain by your side until the day your life meets its destined end. On that day, I will, with all due solemnity, consume your body piece by piece. And your soul shall reside within me, forever.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Do you, too, crave the taste of my flesh, dear Keeper?

daily.title: Chat: About the Crisis
daily.content: My people and I revere the beauty of permanence. Dissolution slowly weathers a living person, wiping away all traces of their existence... Such cruel torture should not be allowed.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: I adore the classic beauty of this institution's Gothic clock tower. And the Awakeners here, ah... They exude an aromatic flavor I've never tasted: a perfect blend of departed fragrance and a trace of living scent. It truly makes me crave a little bite.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: The deceased who have found peace are beautiful and fragrant. Their beauty isn't in the flesh, before or after death, but in their souls. Those souls' enlightenment regarding death, their longing for life, and their desire to be remembered are the delicacies I have always dreamt of.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: There was a man who slowly carved away a young girl's flesh, fingernails, hands, and feet, all while continuously healing her. He didn't want her to die, nor did he want her to live. I could not, of course, grant him a peaceful death. So, I gave him a taste of his own medicine. I wonder how many years he's been trapped there... For someone who desecrates death, this is quite fair, isn't it?

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: No adjective can describe the intoxicating fragrance of your body. It is like the tart aftertaste of a rich Bordeaux wine, and the thick aroma of a mellow, buttery sponge cake. The day of your death will perhaps be the most important event of my remaining time.

daily.title: Chat: About Leigh
daily.content: While that lady's enthusiasm is very touching, her body has a sort of over-fermented, damp smell. Even though she keeps begging me to have a taste, it simply does not suit my palate. How vexing.

daily.title: Chat: About Pickman
daily.content: Like me, Mr. Pickman is in pursuit of immortalized beauty. We could have become closer friends. But he sees eating as a violation of preserved eternity. Such a narrow artistic philosophy.

daily.title: Chat: About Food
daily.content: Why are you so wary of me? You needn't and shouldn't be alarmed; to feed on a living human goes against my aesthetic.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Who shall grace my dinner table today, I wonder?

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: I shall bestow upon you the honour of becoming tonight's feast.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Truly delicious food is always worth the wait.

battle.title: Strike: II
battle.content: This might be a bit chilly.

battle.title: Skill: I
battle.content: I shall bring a clean rest.

battle.title: Skill: II
battle.content: Scatter and fade into the shadows!

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: I am rather eager to begin.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: If death is what you seek, then I shall grant your wish.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Please, entrust your body to me. I will savour you meticulously: every drop of blood, every piece of flesh, every single bone.

traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: As God of Death and Friend to the Departed, I extend a formal salute.

traphase.title: Chat: About Karen
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: What a good servant. Just one final step to true perfection... I'll make you an undead. Miss, would you be interested in joining our feast?

traphase.title: Chat: About Murphy
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: This scent clinging to you... the peculiar yet fragrant aroma of the Deep Sea... I must say, it's quite captivating, Miss Murphy.

traphase.title: Chat: About Salvador
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Hmmm... A faith that praises life. It is, as always, rather boring.

traphase.title: Chat: About Faint
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Having absorbed so much life force, your body remains so tiny and frail... I wonder what it would taste like? Please allow me to savor it after your demise.

traphase.title: Chat: About Pickman
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: I appreciate your talent, but desecrating corpses is contrary to my aesthetics. I offer you a chance to amend this mistake.

traphase.title: Thinking
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Patience is essential. Only complex preparation can unlock the true, layered flavors of the ingredient.

traphase.title: Urging
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Wait any longer, and the delicious food will get cold.

traphase.title: Fatal Blow
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: I shall present you with a fragrant banquet—

traphase.title: Blunder
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
traphase.content: Oops, I fear this course will be undercooked.
